## Quick quiz

::: {.quiz}
::: {.q}
**1. What does an actuary do?**

::: {.fragment .a}
Uses data and maths to put a price on uncertainty, and to manage risk.
:::
:::
::: {.q}
**2. Why do insurers need many customers?**

::: {.fragment .a}
With more customers, the average cost becomes predictable.
:::
:::
::: {.q}
**3. Why can charging the expected cost ($100) still lose money?**

::: {.fragment .a}
It only breaks even *on average*. A few unlucky claims turn it into a loss, so premiums need a buffer.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
About 3 min. Ask each question, take an answer from the room, then press next to reveal it.
:::
